slides.heading: Max Path Sum In Binary Tree
slides.subtitle: AlgoExpert · Hard · Binary Trees
slides.narration: Let's solve Max Path Sum In Binary Tree, a hard binary trees problem. We'll restate the problem, build the intuition, walk through the approach, read the Java solution, and finish with its complexity.

slides.heading: The problem
bullets: Maximum sum over any path (node-to-node, no repeats).
slides.narration: Here's the problem. Maximum sum over any path (node-to-node, no repeats).

slides.heading: Intuition
bullets: At each node, the best path either bends through it or continues upward through one child.
slides.narration: At each node, the best path either bends through it or continues upward through one child.

slides.heading: Brute force vs optimal
bullets: Brute force: every pair of nodes as endpoints → O(n²)
Post-order: return best single branch, update best bend → O(n)
slides.narration: Trying every pair of endpoints is quadratic. In one post-order pass, each node returns its best downward branch and updates a global best for paths that bend through it.

slides.heading: Approach
bullets: 1. Post-order returns the best downward branch
2. A bending path is node plus both positive branches
slides.narration: Step by step. First, post-order returns the best downward branch. Second, a bending path is node plus both positive branches. Third, track the global max.

slides.heading: Java solution
slides.narration: Branch returns zero for null, clamps both children at zero, updates best with value plus both, and returns value plus the larger.

slides.heading: Complexity
slides.narration: Time is O of n. Space is O of h.

slides.heading: Edge cases & pitfalls
bullets: All-negative tree: answer is the max node
Return a single branch, not both
slides.narration: Clamp negative branches to zero, and initialise the best with minus infinity so an all-negative tree returns its largest node.

slides.heading: Interview tips & follow-ups
slides.narration: Explain the difference between what you return, a branch, and what you record, a bend.

slides.heading: Recap
bullets: At each node, the best path either bends through it or continues upward through one child.
slides.narration: To recap Max Path Sum In Binary Tree: At each node, the best path either bends through it or continues upward through one child. Try re-implementing it from scratch without looking.
